name: Knight of the Sea
descriptionTemplate: When commanding ship units, morale will not diminish. When dealing a naval critical attack, increase damage by X%. If a friendly carrier within 2 hexes or if the commander is deployed on a carrier, air strikes, missiles, and nuclear bombs deals +30% damage. All friendly aircraft carriers within 2 hexes gain +15% air strike damage.

longDesc: Compétence spécifique à un général. « Chevalier des mers » monte jusqu'au niveau 5. Au niveau maximum (5), elle applique l'effet suivant : « Lorsque vous commandez des unités navales, la moral ne diminue pas. When dealing a naval attaques critiques, augmente les dégâts de 40%. If a porte-avions allié dans un rayon de 2 hex or if the commander is deployed on a carrier, air strikes, missiles, and nuclear bombs inflige +30% de dégâts. All porte-avions alliés dans un rayon de 2 hex gain +15% air strike dégâts. ». Compétence signature liée à une carte précise, à niveauer quand on investit dans ce général.
longDescEn: A general-specific skill. "Knight of the Sea" scales up to level 5. At max level (5), the skill applies the following effect: "When commanding ship units, morale will not diminish. When dealing a naval critical attack, increase damage by 40%. If a friendly carrier within 2 hexes or if the commander is deployed on a carrier, air strikes, missiles, and nuclear bombs deals +30% damage. All friendly aircraft carriers within 2 hexes gain +15% air strike damage.". A signature tied to a specific card, worth levelling whenever you invest in that general.
longDescDe: Eine generalspezifische Fähigkeit. „Knight of the Sea“ skaliert bis Stufe 5. Auf Maximalstufe (5) wirkt folgender Effekt: „When commanding ship units, morale will not diminish. When dealing a naval critical attack, increase damage by 40%. If a friendly carrier within 2 hexes or if the commander is deployed on a carrier, air strikes, missiles, and nuclear bombs deals +30% damage. All friendly aircraft carriers within 2 hexes gain +15% air strike damage.“. Eine an eine bestimmte Karte gebundene Signatur, die beim Investieren geleveled werden sollte.
